purpose: Six text-free vertical scenes illustrating evidence strength, task specificity, and method variation in inattentional-blindness research.
sourcePolicy: Scene captions are composited separately at render time. No approved scene contains embedded words, fake data, logos, brands, watermarks, medical claims, or real-person imitation.
quotaRecoveryDisclosure: Scene 1 was generated as an original AI visual. The requested reference-conditioned AI batch for scenes 2–6 was rejected because the free-plan image-generation quota had been reached (20/20). The quota was not bypassed. Instead, five original deterministic SVG motion-graphics scenes were authored locally from the approved storyboard and rasterized with Chromium. This preserves a distinct original visual sequence while accurately disclosing the mixed production route.
